playback_policy: One shared 16 s presentation clock per task. Rendered trajectory clips keep a Rendered badge throughout playback. The original eleven task videos retain their existing native playback. Only Box 02 and Pick-and-place 01–03 use held boundary images outside recorded estimate intervals. No poses are extrapolated. Separate recordings share normalized reference progress, not a common absolute timestamp.
